description: Run a feed immediately over its own window and record what it finds. Use it right after creating one to prove the mapping works — a run that comes back `empty` names the path that missed, which is what you fix with ledger_feeds_update. Does not move the feed's schedule. Re-running is safe: readings dedupe per time bucket. May return `needs_confirmation`.
